title: Mononuclear cobalt(II) complexes with polypyridyl ligands: Synthesis, characterization, DNA interactions and in vitro cytotoxicity towards human cancer cells.
authors: Karumban, Kalai Selvan; Raut, Rajnikant; Gupta, Parth; Muley, Arabinda; Giri, Bishnubasu; Kumbhakar, Sadananda; Misra, Ashish; Maji, Somnath
one_liner_zh: 该文研究钴配合物的合成及其与DNA的相互作用，包含分子对接但核心为化学合成与细胞毒性实验，非TF-DNA体系且方法深度有限。
abstract: Mononuclear cobalt(II) complexes [Co(II)(L(1))Cl(2)]; 1, [Co(II)(L(1))(bpy)Cl]PF(6); 2, [Co(II)(L(1))(phen)Cl]PF(6); 3 and [Co(II)(L(2))Cl(2)]; 4 (where L(1) = N,N-bis(pyridin-2-ylmethyl)aniline, L(2) = (2,4,6-trimethyl-N,N-bis(pyridin-2-ylmethyl)aniline, bpy = 2,2(/)-bipyridine, phen = 1,10-phenanthroline) were synthesized and characterized by different analytical and spectroscopic methods. All the complexes were structurally identified by single-crystal X-ray crystallography. Penta-coordinated complex 1 adopted distorted trigonal bipyramidal and hexacoordinated complexes 2 and 3 having distorted octahedral geometry whereas tetra-coordinated complex 4 has distorted tetrahedral geometry. The interactions of salmon sperm DNA (ss-DNA) with complexes (1-4) were investigated by absorbance, fluorescence spectroscopy and molecular docking studies. All the complexes are very susceptible to DNA binding and the binding affinity (K(b)) follows the order 3 (2.05 x 10(4) M (-1)) > 4 (1.40 x 10(4) M (-1)) > 2 (1.36 x 10(4) M (-1)) > 1 (1.34 x 10(4) M (-1)) indicating they have superior DNA binding ability. The Stern-Volmer constant (K(sv)) ranges from 1.10 x 10(4) M (-1) to 1.95 x 10(4) M (-1) suggesting weak or moderate binding with DNA. DNA cleavage study in plasmid DNA reveals very efficient DNA cleavage factors even in the absence of any external agents. Using multiple biochemical assays, we have demonstrated that 1-4 induces apoptosis of human cancer cells with IC(50) values of 26.48 +/- 1.45 muM, 10.89 +/- 0.55 muM, 7.63 +/- 0.4 muM and 37.67 +/- 2.06 muM, respectively in A549 lung adenocarcinoma cells and 14.45 +/- 0.73 muM, 1.97 +/- 0.1 muM, 0.98 +/- 0.05 muM and 24.43 +/- 1.22 muM, respectively in MDA-MB-231 breast adenocarcinoma cells.
abstract_zh: 单核钴(II)配合物[Co(II)(L(1))Cl(2)]；1，[Co(II)(L(1))(bpy)Cl]PF(6)；2，[Co(II)(L(1))(phen)Cl]PF(6)；3和[Co(II)(L(2))Cl(2)]；4（其中L(1) = N,N-双(吡啶-2-基甲基)苯胺，L(2) = (2,4,6-三甲基-N,N-双(吡啶-2-基甲基)苯胺，bpy = 2,2'-联吡啶，phen = 1,10-菲咯啉）被合成并通过不同的分析和光谱方法进行表征。所有配合物均通过单晶X射线晶体学进行结构鉴定。五配位配合物1采用畸变三角双锥几何构型，六配位配合物2和3具有畸变八面体几何构型，而四配位配合物4具有畸变四面体几何构型。通过吸光度、荧光光谱和分子对接研究，考察了鲑鱼精子DNA（ss-DNA）与配合物（1-4）的相互作用。所有配合物对DNA结合非常敏感，结合亲和力（K(b)）遵循顺序3（2.05 x 10(4) M (-1)）> 4（1.40 x 10(4) M (-1)）> 2（1.36 x 10(4) M (-1)）> 1（1.34 x 10(4) M (-1)），表明它们具有优异的DNA结合能力。Stern-Volmer常数（K(sv)）范围从1.10 x 10(4) M (-1)到1.95 x 10(4) M (-1)，提示与DNA结合较弱或中等。质粒DNA中的DNA切割研究表明，即使在没有任何外部试剂的情况下，也具有非常高效的DNA切割因子。通过多种生化分析，我们证明1-4诱导人癌细胞凋亡，在A549肺腺癌细胞中的IC(50)值分别为26.48 +/- 1.45 μM、10.89 +/- 0.55 μM、7.63 +/- 0.4 μM和37.67 +/- 2.06 μM，在MDA-MB-231乳腺腺癌细胞中分别为14.45 +/- 0.73 μM、1.97 +/- 0.1 μM、0.98 +/- 0.05 μM和24.43 +/- 1.22 μM。
